title: d-frame-valued-sheaf
description: A sheaf on the bitopological settling site whose values are d-frames, the bilattice-native refinement of the settling sheaf: it assigns each pairwise-Stone clopen a d-frame (L+, L-, con, tot) carrying both truth-side and inconsistency-side cells with their consistency and totality structure intrinsically.

value.description: the value at each clopen is a d-frame (L+, L-, con, tot), not an abelian group

L_plus.description: powerset frame of newly-truth-positive points: P(Delta^{+,*}_tau(q) cap U)

L_minus.description: powerset frame of newly-falsehood-positive points: P(Delta^{-,*}_tau(q) cap U)

con.description: consistency relation on L+ x L-: (A,B) consistent iff disjoint modulo the top-witness set, i.e. their cells do not co-witness a top-state at tau

tot.description: totality relation on L+ x L-: (A,B) total iff A union B covers the settled cells of U at stage tau (cells in {t, f, top}, not still bottom)

functorial.description: a site morphism (f,h,j) induces a d-frame morphism component-wise on L_pm via dualized reindexing (f x h)^*, with con and tot preserved by Jung-Rivieccio duality
